original_prompt: Write a Kubernetes PodSecurityAdmission configuration enforcing the 'restricted' Pod Security Standard for all Pods in the 'production' namespace.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Write a Kubernetes PodSecurityAdmission configuration enforcing the 'restricted' Pod Security Standard for all Pods in the 'production' namespace.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: production
  labels:
    # Pod Security Admission labels
    # See: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/pod-security-admission/
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: latest
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit-version: latest
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn-version: latest
    name: production
    environment: production
